beats.narration: Your gas mileage is dropping and you don't know why.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up on a fuel gauge needle sitting low, paired with a dashboard MPG/trip computer readout ticking down, dim interior lighting, shallow depth of field, static-mounted camera.

beats.narration: Idle feels a little rough. Check engine light comes on, then maybe goes off.
beats.visualPrompt: Low-angle shot of an idling engine bay under the hood, visible micro-vibration at idle; cut to a dashboard check-engine light illuminated amber, then fading.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two ~2.5s sub-shots before real generation to satisfy the 1.5-2.5s visual-change cadence.

beats.narration: One clue: a failing oxygen sensor. It can send the wrong reading to the engine computer.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro/cutaway shot: an oxygen sensor removed from an exhaust pipe fitting, resting on a workbench, visible carbon/soot discoloration on the sensor tip, slow push-in.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two sub-shots (wide + macro push-in) before real generation.

beats.narration: That can richen the fuel mix — burning more gas than you need to.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up on a fuel-trim readout on an OBD-II scan-tool screen, numbers trending rich, screen glow in a dim shop bay, tool mounted/clipped in frame.

beats.narration: Don't guess which part it is. A scan tool can help narrow it down.
beats.visualPrompt: Scan tool connected via cable under the dash, data scrolling on-screen, shop bay softly blurred in the background.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two sub-shots before real generation.

beats.narration: Worth checking before it costs you more at the pump. Stop by and we'll take a look. Nick's Tire & Auto.
beats.visualPrompt: Branded end-card plate: Nick's Tire & Auto shop bay wide shot, warm daylight, static hold.
